		required_missions = { jxp_map_mission_stm_peninsula_defense }
		trigger = {
			mission_completed = jxp_mission_daimyo_tenka_strategy
			num_of_cities = 15
			prestige = 30
			num_of_ports = 6
		}
		effect = {
			jxp_map_initialize_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_map_major_daimyo_mission_replay_guard } }
				add_navy_tradition = 10
				add_prestige = 20
				jxp_add_tenka_order_10_effect = yes
				add_country_modifier = {
					name = jxp_map_15_stm_legacy
					duration = 9125
				}
				set_country_flag = jxp_24_house_path_completed
			}
		}
	}

}
